purpose: Teach: 文体/電動/見送り/例文/厚み/大きめ/学費/利上げ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広報文の文体、統一感、出せ。
lines.en: Get the PR text cohesive. Unify the style.
lines.style: Sharp, clipped delivery. Minimal air between phrases. Direct eye contact. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。電動工具、新型に交換しました。
lines.en: Understood. We've swapped out the power tools for the new models.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No color in the voice — just the facts. Slight nod-like rhythm, confirming completion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期、案件、見送りの判断、慎重に。
lines.en: This quarter, be more careful about which projects you defer.
lines.style: Measured and deliberate. Weight on 'careful' — not a casual instruction. Speaks as though imparting something Kenji should already know.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。例文、新人向け資料に組み込みました。
lines.en: Got it. I've incorporated example sentences into the new-hire training materials.
lines.style: Quiet efficiency. No flourish — just the update delivered. Slightly faster than the previous line, as if moving down a checklist.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: パンフ、紙の厚み、贅沢にしろ。
lines.en: Make the brochure paper heavier. More substantial.
lines.style: Crisp, commanding. Emphasis on 'heavier' — this is deliberate quality. Voice carries a note of someone who thinks in details.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サイズは、大きめで、目立つように。
lines.en: Understood. We'll go bigger on the size — make it stand out.
lines.style: Affirmative and steady. No hesitation. Tracks the instruction precisely, adding his own reinforcement on 'stand out.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学費支援、社員制度に組み込め。
lines.en: Work tuition support into the employee benefits package.
lines.style: Short, decisive. Each clause lands with quiet weight. The voice of someone delegating something final, not negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。利上げ局面、財務、慎重に運用します。
lines.en: Yes. With interest rates rising, I'll be careful how we manage cash flow.
lines.style: Final note of the conversation — slightly more thoughtful. Acknowledges the broader context. Closes with quiet assurance, no rush.
